scope: Read-only bounded analysis of the rejected boxed root-handle conversion. This supplements the passing hash/Clone code-generation audit and preserves the failing performance result. No compiler, linker or benchmark was run by this audit.

exact_lane.description: The conversion key exists. A Ref<FerroObject> contains an Other instance; the runtime cast to unrelated Target rejects it. This is distinct from the bool borrowed_wrong map miss and successful typed boxed_live.

route_correction.baseline_source: register_conversion<TFrom,TTo> inserts ConvertFn::Borrowed(BorrowedConversion::Shared(Rc callback)). register_element_ref invokes it for Ref<FerroObject> -> ElementRef<T> and its nullable target.
route_correction.baseline_runtime: Borrowed Shared: apply invokes as_any, then the Rc callback performs Any downcast and class cast directly.
route_correction.stage4_runtime: FromRoot: apply performs as_any and Any downcast, then invokes the static reference callback, which performs the class cast.
route_correction.correction: Any earlier description of this baseline route as the internal ConvertFn::Boxed variant is superseded by the exact source and native callback. The public API takes a boxed value; its original internal converter is Borrowed(Shared).

native_findings.finding: No additional call boundary or ownership operation was found in the measured rejection route.
native_findings.detail: Excluding common public/TLS/map work, both routes invoke as_any, Any::type_id, one converter callback, Ref<FerroObject>::cast<Target> and TypeInfo::is_assignable_from. Baseline cloned/dropped the shared callback Rc; stage4 copies the static pointer and does not clone an owning root handle before the class cast. Both return None before output allocation on this lane.

native_findings.finding: The class-check implementations are unchanged in instruction sequence.
native_findings.detail: cast<Target> is 83 bytes / 28 instructions and is_assignable_from is 29 bytes / 11 instructions in reference, stage4 and isolated Clone trial. The stage4 static reference leaf is 122 bytes and matches the isolated trial instruction sequence.

native_findings.finding: The passing hash and clone checks remain valid.
native_findings.detail: Both native map lookup routes retain call-free pair hashing. No outer ConvertFn or nested BorrowedConversion Clone body/call was reintroduced.

native_findings.finding: Fresh PGO changes instruction placement and branch direction.
native_findings.detail: The FromRoot apply block starts at 0x78 in stage4 and 0xc1 in the isolated trial. Stage4 tag 3 cleanup takes two conditional branches to the return; isolated cleanup takes one branch then falls through a comparison. Stage4 cleanup instructions match baseline cleanup, but the original tag 0 shared-Rc path uses a different arm. No causal percentage or attribution to alignment/cache/branch prediction is established.

native_findings.finding: The FromRoot dispatcher arm is covered by training.
native_findings.detail: Accepted stage4 apply entry count is 12,889; switch weights are Borrowed 12,424, StaticBox 144, Boxed 64, FromRoot 257, Number 0. The residual path is not explained by a zero-count FromRoot arm.

long_balanced_control_cohorts.method: Focused follow-up to the stage4 rejected-boxed signal. Existing unmodified binaries, three warmup blocks, two lanes, five million operations per process, all six orders of candidate/reference/same-image reference control, alternating lane order. Same-image control runs the exact reference executable as a separate fresh process. This supplements rather than replaces the original rotated short-process cohorts. No profile training or source change.

timing_interpretation: Both original 31-pair cohorts flagged boxed_wrong. The reference-first/reference-fast grouping describes the short-process bimodality; it is not a replacement gate.

The longer CPU6 control experiment confirms a persistent rejected-path slowdown: candidate/reference 1.39284 with 95% interval 1.32921–1.43326, candidate/identical reference-control 1.39140, while the same-image control interval includes 1. Successful boxed conversion improves in that cohort.
The longer CPU7 cohort includes parity for both rejected and successful paths; it does not erase the CPU6 failure. No averaging or exclusion of CPU6 is used to declare acceptance.

The inspection has not identified a new extra call or class-check implementation change that explains the magnitude. The narrower callback-boundary trial is a hypothesis to test; branch/layout observations are not an asserted cause.

proposed_source_only_trial.change: Replace only the two Ref<FerroObject> to weak-element conversion callbacks with BorrowedConversion::Static leaves, placing root Any downcast and class cast directly in each concrete leaf. Keep the shared installer and all public signatures.

descriptor_estimate.note: Source-level thin function-pointer descriptor estimate only. Linked section/code/relocation size must be measured; no estimate of total binary or native text delta is claimed.

semantic_checks.reason: set_conversion is retained. Registration::Conversion exposes neither cast nor borrowed implicit-conversion view even though its boxed converter uses the Borrowed variant internally.
The three earlier set_cast calls and their order are unchanged. set_conversion retains the existing independent cast and borrowed views inside OverrideRoutes.

semantic_checks.case: Pre-existing custom cast or captured conversion
semantic_checks.reason: Registry::set_conversion is unchanged: it preserves earlier cast/borrowed views and replaces only the conversion. Re-registration still restores the built-in converter at the same point in the same key order.

semantic_checks.case: Any downcast and wrong runtime subclass
semantic_checks.reason: Both routes invoke AnyValue::as_any once through ConvertFn::Borrowed, then downcast_ref<Ref<FerroObject>> and cast<T>. Either failure returns None before boxing. This is the same underlying as_any/downcast sequence as FromRoot.

semantic_checks.case: Successful nonnullable and nullable root conversion
semantic_checks.reason: Each direct leaf holds the temporary successful Ref<T>, creates the same weak ElementRef, boxes exactly ElementRef<T> or Some(ElementRef<T>), then drops the temporary handle. No owned Rc callback adapter or pre-cast strong-handle clone is introduced.
The class cast uses ? before Some wrapping, so it still returns conversion failure None, not a boxed nullable null.
The from_object: reference::<T> field and element_ref_objects insertion are unchanged. Compiler metadata, object-to-weak lookup callback and its public behavior are retained.
Lookup still clones the converter out of the registry before invocation; only the contained static function representation changes. The installer performs no callback invocation.

proposed_source_only_trial.unchanged: Hash annotation, manual ConvertFn Clone, registry representation, setter methods, public lookup methods, nullable registration, remaining typed/expired conversions, metadata, class/interface/property registration and all public API signatures.
proposed_source_only_trial.validation_limits: Source review and patch applicability only; no source checkout was modified and no compiler, linker, test or benchmark was run.

commands: Read the immutable cohort JSONs referenced above; the longer runner rotates all six process orders and includes the exact reference executable as a second arm.

limits: Selected normalized instruction records omit redundant symbol annotations but retain instruction offsets and relocation targets. Final machine placement was not causally tested. The proposed patch has only source/semantic/applicability review and must be compiled and measured before any performance claim.
